items.title: EasyJet investors back Apollo buyout as deal moves closer to completion
items.summary: Investing.com -- EasyJet shareholders approved Apollo’s takeover of the budget airline on Wednesday, clearing a key hurdle for the deal, which still requires court sanction and regulatory approvals and is expected to complete in the first quarter of 2027.
